blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: AI voice assistants often use Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) with an LLM reasoning, yet, existing systems struggle with regional British accents (Scottish, Irish, Welsh), since most ASR models are trained predominantly on American English voice data. Consequently, errors carry through to the LLM stage, corrupting tool-call arguments and producing wrong or missing responses, which is especially costly in finance. Deployable ASR must also meet tight latency and memory budgets, making an accent-robust model choice even harder. We introduce CavaBench, the first internally collected benchmark of spoken financial queries, and use it to evaluate a range of ASR models and their full ASR-LLM pipeline behavior across self-reported British accents. We find that WER strongly predicts downstream tool-calling accuracy (r = -0.93) but can fail to reflect task-level performance, with accent-related failures varying substantially across models and acoustic conditions. These findings guide the design of more inclusive, reliable voice-based financial assistants.
blocks.zh: AI语音助理经常使用带有LLM推理的"自动语音识别"(ASR),然而,现有的系统却与区域性的英国口音(斯科特语,爱尔兰语,威尔士语)相冲突,因为大多数ASR模型主要是对美国英语语音数据的培训. 因此,错误一直延伸到LLM阶段,破坏了工具调用的论点,产生了错误或缺失的答复,这在金融方面特别昂贵。 可部署的ASR还必须满足紧凑的延迟和内存预算,使口音阻塞模式的选择更加困难. 我们介绍Cava Bench,这是第一个内部收集的口语财务查询基准,并用它来评价一系列ASR模型及其完整的ASR-LLM管道行为跨越自报的英国口音. 我们发现WER对下游工具调用精度(r = -0.93)进行了强烈的预测,但无法反映任务级别性能,不同模型和声学条件中与口音相关的故障差异很大. 这些调查结果指导设计更具包容性、更可靠的语音财务助理。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Most finance virtual assistants are text-based [ 1 ] ; speech interfaces are a more natural, engaging alternative [ 2 ] but add Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) as a source of error. State-of-the-art voice assistants (VAs) increasingly combine ASR with Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning in a cascade. These systems generalize well for well-represented language groups but remain fragile to regional accents, especially British English accents (Scottish, Irish, Welsh), because most ASR systems are optimized for American English. Accent-induced errors compound downstream, so VAs misrepresent user intent and systematically underperform for specific accent groups.
blocks.zh: 大多数融资虚拟助手都是以文本为基础的 [1];语音界面是比较自然的,会接触备选案文 [2],但会加入自动语音识别(ASR)作为出错的来源. 先进的语音助理(VA)在级联中越来越多地将ASR和大语言模型(LLM)推理结合起来. 这些系统对代表性好的语言组进行通俗化,但依然易受到区域口音的影响,特别是英国英语口音(斯科特语,爱尔兰语,威尔士语),因为大多数ASR系统都是为美国英语而优化. Accent引起的出错使下游复合,因此VAs对用户意图不实,对特定口音组系统表现不佳.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Cascaded voice-assistant pipeline. The streaming ASR stage and its downstream effect on LLM tool-calling accuracy.
blocks.zh: 图1 混音辅助管道。 流出ASR阶段及其对LLM工具调用精度的影响.

blocks.en: This work is motivated by two complementary, and at times competing, requirements for a production-grade ASR component handling financial queries: (i) accent robustness , since ASR trained predominantly on American-accented speech introduces systematic bias against specific customer groups rather than uniform error; and (ii) streaming efficiency without sacrificing accuracy , since a deployed component must emit transcripts incrementally for a responsive assistant while still supporting correct downstream tool-calling. These requirements must be optimized jointly, since the accent-robustness gap is not static – it widens or narrows with the chosen latency operating point.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的动机是两个互补的、有时相互竞争的ASR部分处理财务询问的要求:(一) 突出稳健性,因为ASR主要接受关于美国语的演讲培训,对特定客户群体产生系统性偏见,而不是统一错误;(二) 流出效率不牺牲准确性,因为部署的部分必须逐步向反应灵敏的助理发放记录誊本,同时仍然支持正确的下游工具调用。 这些要求必须共同优化,因为口音-硬度差距不是静态的-随着所选的延迟操作点而扩大或缩小.

blocks.en: To our knowledge, no publicly available benchmark targets spoken financial queries, annotated by British-accent group, a prerequisite for measuring accent robustness in this setting rather than in general-purpose speech. We study how accent affects streaming ASR Word Error Rate (WER), and how that error propagates into end-to-end task completion, measured through the tool-calling behavior of the downstream LLM. However, WER weights all word errors equally, but effects on a financial assistant are highly unequal: errors in task-critical tokens such as merchant names, monetary amounts, dates, durations, and temporal expressions can change the resulting tool call, while errors in less informative words may have little effect on task completion. Our main contributions are: (i) CavaBench, the first internally collected, human-labeled audio benchmark for spoken financial queries, balanced across four British-accent categories; (ii) a joint evaluation of accent and acoustic robustness across various simulated acoustic conditions, linking ASR WER to downstream tool-calling Exact Match (EM).
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,没有公开提供的基准指标,即英国英分集团注解的口头财务询问,这是在这一背景下而不是在通用发言中衡量重音强度的先决条件。 我们研究口音如何影响流出 ASR Word 错误率(WER),以及该错误如何传播到端到端任务完成,通过下游LLM的工具调用行为进行测量. 然而,WER将所有文字错误的权重都相等,但对财务助理的影响是高度不平等的:任务关键符号如商名,货币金额,日期,持续时间等的错误,以及时间表达方式可能会改变由此而来的工具调用,而信息较少的词中的错误可能对任务完成影响不大. 我们的主要贡献是:(一) 卡瓦·本奇(Cava Bench),这是第一个内部收集的,标有人类标签的用于口语财务查询的音频基准,平衡了4个英分类别;(二) 对各种模拟声学条件的口音和声学强度进行联合评价,将ASR WER与下游工具调用精确匹配(EM)联系起来.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work and Methods
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作和方法

blocks.en: Accent and dialect bias in ASR. Large-scale audits document systematic ASR disparities across speaker demographics: Koenecke et al. [ 3 ] found higher WER for African American speakers across five commercial systems, and DiChristofano et al. [ 4 ] showed ASR performance correlates with speakers’ country of origin. Within British English, Markl [ 5 ] showed algorithmic bias reflects existing prejudice against non-standard varieties. Demirsahin et al. [ 7 ] released open-source multi-speaker corpora of British Isles accents to support more equitable ASR. Accent benchmarks such as VCTK [ 8 ] (British-accent read speech), EdAcc [ 9 ] (spontaneous conversational speech across global English varieties), and Common Voice [ 10 ] (crowd-sourced multilingual speech) evaluate general accent robustness. In these, the American English WERs are consistently several points lower than British varieties – 9.4% vs. 15.2–16.6% on VCTK and ∼ \sim 11% vs. 14–15% on Common Voice – an error range consistent with the realistic acoustic conditions we simulate in this work. To our knowledge, none of this work evaluates accent robustness in the financial domain: CavaBench pairs accent variability with financial queries and evaluates the full cascaded pipeline rather than ASR in isolation.
blocks.zh: ASR中的语调和方言偏差. 大规模审计记录了各发言人人口结构之间系统性的ASR差异: 克内克等. [3] 在五个商业系统中发现非洲裔美国人的WER更高,以及DiChristofano等人. [4] 显示ASR的表现与发言者的原籍国有关。 在英国英语中,Markl [5] 表现出了算法偏差,反映了现有对非标准品种的偏见. 德米尔萨欣等. [7]发布开源多语种 英属岛屿口音支持更公平的ASR. VCTK [8](英国-accent读取语音),EdAcc [9](自发对话演讲跨越全球英语品种)等Accent基准,以及"共同之声"[10](人群-来源多语种语音)评价一般口音稳健性. 美国英语的WER一直比英国的品种低好几分 — — 在VCTK上为9.4%对15.2–16.6%,在Common Voice上为\sim 11%对14–15% — — 这个误差范围符合我们在本作中模拟的现实声学条件. 据我们所知,这项工作都没有评价金融领域的稳健性: Cava Bench将重音可变性与财务询问相配,并单独评价整条级联管线而不是ASR.

blocks.en: ASR architecture families. The evaluated systems span four families. FastConformer-transducer models [ 14 ] (Parakeet [ 19 ] , Nemotron [ 20 ] ) can be configured for offline or streaming ASR depending on encoder context and decoder design. While both 0.6B models share a FastConformer backbone, Parakeet TDT pairs full-context encoder attention with a TDT decoder for high-accuracy offline decoding. In contrast, the Nemotron streaming model uses a cache-aware FastConformer encoder with causal convolutions and limited-context attention, alongside a frame-synchronous RNN-T decoder for low-latency incremental processing (Section 5). Attention encoder–decoder models (Whisper [ 21 ] ) process fixed-length windows with full-context attention and are offline-oriented. Audio-conditioned language models (Qwen3-ASR [ 22 ] ) achieve strong offline accuracy but are less suited to low-latency streaming. The fourth family (Cohere Offline) is available only through a hosted API, with undisclosed architecture. RNN-T [ 11 ] established the streaming formulation underlying the first family. Subsequent advances in Conformer encoders [ 13 ] and on-device streaming [ 12 ] improved the accuracy–latency trade-off. However, these advances have rarely been evaluated jointly for accent robustness and downstream tool-calling correctness.
blocks.zh: ASR建筑家族. 评估的系统涵盖四个家庭。 FastConformer-transcer models [14] (Parakeet [19],Nemotron [20])可以根据编码器上下文和解码器设计,为离线或流出ASR进行配置. 虽然0.6B两种型号都共享一个快康前置主干线,但Parakeet TDT配对了全康文本编码器关注,并配有高精度离线解码的TDT解码器. 相形之下,尼莫特龙流线模型使用缓存-意识快conformer编码器,并带有因果演化和有限的文本关注,同时使用帧同步的RNN-T解码器来进行低纬度递增处理(第5节). 注意编码器-解码器模型(Whisper [21]) 处理有全文本注意并面向下线的固定长窗口. 音频有条件语言模型(Quen3-ASR [22])实现强离线精度,但不太适合低纬度流线. 第四家族(英语:Cohere Offline)只能通过主机API提供,拥有未公开的架构. RNN-T [11] 确立了第一个家族背后的流派配方. 随后在Conformer编码器[13]和接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接 然而,这些进展很少被联合评价,以强调强健性和下游工具调用正确性。

blocks.en: Error propagation into downstream understanding. Avila et al. [ 15 ] studied how ASR errors degrade NLU in cascaded spoken language understanding, and Jung and Choi [ 16 ] found that WER alone does not fully explain semantic degradation in ASR–LLM cascades. This motivates task-level metrics alongside transcription-level ones; we therefore evaluate tool-calling EM to examine how accent-related ASR errors affect downstream performance in finance. The ASR transcript is the sole textual representation of customer intent available to the LLM, and errors often corrupt the low-frequency, high-perplexity tokens on which tool-calling depends most, such as amounts, dates and merchant names. A single substitution in such a token can silently redirect a tool call, and a user acting on the result may make a materially incorrect financial decision.
blocks.zh: 向下游传播错误。 阿维拉等. [15] 研究了ASR错误如何在级联口语理解中降解NLU,而郑和崔[16]发现,单是WER并不能充分解释ASR-LLM级联中的语义降解. 这激励了任务层面的衡量标准与转录层面的衡量标准;因此,我们评价调用工具的EM,以审查与口音有关的ASR错误如何影响下游金融业绩。 ASR笔录是LLM所能获取的客户意向的唯一文字表现,出错往往会腐蚀工具调用最依赖的低频,高复杂符号,如金额,日期和商名等. 这种符号中的单一替代可以默默地重新定位一个工具呼叫,而根据结果行事的用户可能作出重大错误的财务决定.

blocks.en: 3 CavaBench: Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 Cava Bench: 数据集

blocks.en: Cascaded ASR–LLM pipelines degrade for underrepresented accents, and in financial this can cause failed tasks, reduced user trust, and can create measurable bias. No prior benchmark targets this domain–accent intersection, motivating CavaBench ( C ascaded A udio and V oice A ssistant Benchmarking). It was collected from 90 participants (50 male/40 female) via an in-house recording interface, in a clean acoustic environment, isolating accent as the primary variable. Acoustic robustness is evaluated separately, under the acoustic conditions in Section 5 (Section 5.2 ). Each speaker recorded at least one round of 20 queries sampled from a pool of 200 realistic financial queries, including spending summaries, budget tracking, merchant lookups, trend analysis and numerical queries. The queries were phrased naturally to elicit realistic prosody, yielding 3,079 utterances of which 2,919 were retained after quality inspection, with reference transcripts taken directly from the prompt text. Utterance duration averages 4.73 s (range 2.16–20.82 s; 3.94 h total). Self-reported accent (76 raw free-text values) was grouped to support balanced group-level comparisons: Scottish ( ∼ \sim 685, ∼ \sim 23 speakers), Southern English ( ∼ \sim 710, ∼ \sim 23), Other British ( ∼ \sim 747, ∼ \sim 20 – Northern Irish, Mancunian, Yorkshire, Welsh, Midlands), Non-British ( ∼ \sim 784, ∼ \sim 26).
blocks.zh: Cascaded ASR-LLM 管道因代表不足的口音而退化,在财务上这会导致任务失败,降低用户信任度并产生可测量的偏差. 先前的基准没有针对这个域-accent相交点,激发出Cava Bench(Cacaded A udio and Voice A sistant Basiting). 它从90名参与者(50名男性/40名女性)那里通过内部录制界面收集,在干净的相声环境中,将口音隔离为主变量. 第5节(第5.2节)中的声学强度在声学条件下单独评估。 每个发言者至少记录了从200个实际财务查询中抽取的20个查询,包括支出摘要、预算跟踪、商家查询、趋势分析和数字查询。 提出这些询问自然是为了获得现实的假象,得出3 079个说法,其中2 919个在质量检查后保留,参考记录直接取自即时文本。 平均使用期限 4.73 s(范围为2.16至20.82 s;共计3.94 h)。 自报口音(76个原始自由文字值)被分组,以支持均衡的组级比较: 苏格兰语(\sim 685,\sim 23 speakers),南英语(\sim 710,\sim 23),其他英国语(\sim 747,\sim 20 – 北爱尔兰语,曼库尼亚语,约克郡,威尔士语,中地语),非英国语(\sim 784,\sim 26).

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en:
ASR models and configurations. We evaluate: (i) Nemotron Streaming (0.6B parameters) 1 1 1 Fine-tuned in-house on internal data; our regulatory and data-governance constraints permit in-house fine-tuning only for open-weight models such as this one. is evaluated using Baseline and Finetuned variants, at two streaming lookahead settings, LA6 and LA13 yielding four configurations. 2 2 2 The corpus contains various British-accented financial queries recorded under telephony-style channel and noise conditions and internally cleaned and filtered for transcription accuracy. Shorter lookahead settings were also evaluated but underperformed relative to longer lookaheads. Similarly, the larger Parakeet-RNNT-1.1B underperformed. (ii) Parakeet-TDT-0.6B is evaluated as both a Base Offline variant and a Parakeet v2 0.6B variant, the latter fine-tuned in-house on the same corpus using a gated encoder adapter on its 24-layer FastConformer encoder with TDT loss (lr= 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} ). (iii) Qwen3-ASR-1.7B is evaluated offline using chunked pseudo-streaming mode (audio processed in 1-sec chunks), hereafter Qwen3-ASR-1.7B Chunking . (iv) Whisper Turbo and Distil-Whisper , and (v) Cohere Offline are evaluated as offline references.
Note that in this work, we fine-tune the smaller Nemotron and Parakeet ASR models with additional in-domain data to investigate the effect of targeted adaptation on end-to-end performance.

(二) Parakeet-TDT-0.6B被评价为Base离线变体和Parakeet v2 0.6B变体,后者在同一种生物体上使用装有门的编码器对内部进行微调,在其24层有TDT损失(lr=3 × 10 − 5 3\tims 10^{-5})的快 conformer编码器上安装有门的编码器。 (三) Qune3-ASR-1.7B被评价为离线参照物(用一分块处理的音频),下称Qune3-ASR-1.7B Chunking。 (四) Whisper Turbo和Distil-Whisper, (五) Cohere离线被评价为离线参考物。
请注意,在这项工作中,我们对较小的Nemotron和Parakeet ASR模型进行了微调,增加了域内数据,以调查定向适应对端到端性能的影响.

blocks.en: Deployment-relevant properties. Nemotron Streaming’s cache-aware design gives it a substantial deployment edge over the alternatives: roughly 3.5 × \times lower latency and less than half the memory footprint of Qwen3-ASR-1.7B Chunking, the closest streaming-emulating alternative, the latency of which stays high because its non-causal encoder must re-decode a growing prefix on every chunk rather than reuse cached state. None of the other evaluated models are natively streaming. LLM reasoning component. Tool-calling is performed by Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it reasoning model (Fig. 1 ), prompted with the same tool schema for all ASR transcripts. Query set and gold labels. We use the same 200-query from CavaBench (Section 4). Gold tool-call labels are obtained by running a 10-fold LLM validation on each of the 200 reference queries, and taking the majority-vote as gold, with manual inspection. Task-level metric. Exact Match (EM) is computed over five tool-call fields: metric , time_period , group_by , filter , and compare_with ; a prediction counts as correct only if all five fields match gold. Acoustic conditions. Each recording is evaluated under 6 groups, across all 4 accent groups: Clean (unmodified); Noise – MUSAN [ 17 ] additive noise/music/babble, +20 to − 5 -5 dB SNR; Overlap – competing-speaker babble, +20 to +5 dB SIR; Reverb – RIRS_NOISES [ 18 ] convolution, RT60 0.3–0.8 s; Environment – compound device/codec profiles with speaker-level attenuation; Telephony – narrowband codec/bandwidth degradation, evaluated separately.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Accent-robustness results (Clean condition)
blocks.zh: 5.1 干燥结果(清洁条件)

blocks.en: Table 1 reports WER by accent group, averaged (sample-weighted) across 6 acoustic condition groups. Text normalization lowercases text, strips punctuation, and canonicalizes numbers and currency. First, fine-tuning helps Nemotron Streaming without widening the accent gap: Nemotron (FT-LA13) improves overall WER from 18.2% to 16.1%, and narrows the max-min accent spread (1.5% vs. 2.3%, the fairness metric in Section 7). Second, applying the same procedure to Parakeet narrows the accent spread from 2.7% to 1.7%, with only a marginal improvement in overall WER (16.6% to 16.5%) and EM is not improved. Third, accent sensitivity is model-dependent: Qwen3-ASR-1.7B Chunking has the largest spread of any model (9.4%, driven by Scottish speech collapse at 22.2%). Cohere Offline achieves the third-lowest overall WER (15.3%) and one of the tightest accent spreads (1.6%). In the Clean-only condition, overall EM ranges from 75.1% (Nemotron Base-LA6) to 80.7% (Qwen3-ASR-1.7B Offline); with fine-tuning raising Nemotron Streaming’s (LA13) EM from 75.5% to 78.2%.

blocks.en: 5.2 Robustness across acoustic conditions
blocks.zh: 5.2 跨声道条件的强健性

blocks.en: ASR robustness decreases monotonically across conditions: Clean (6.0% WER) < < Reverb (9.8%) < < Noise (11.8%) < < Telephony (12.9%) < < Overlap (20.0%) < < Environment (28.6%) (Figs. 3 – 3 ), confirming joint degradation (Environment) is substantially harder. All models do not degrade uniformly: Whisper Turbo, differing from its distilled variant only in the decoder size, has the steepest single-condition collapse (29% WER at Environment), while Qwen3-ASR-1.7B Offline is the most robust throughout, retaining the highest EM except for Reverb. Cohere Offline is behind only the two Qwen3-ASR-1.7B variants. The Nemotron Streaming baseline, comparable in scale to Parakeet but 2-4 × \times smaller than the Whisper and Qwen3-ASR-1.7B shows less robustness, likely because it uses less acoustically diverse pretraining data, and model size. The fine-tuned models reduce the gap at Telephony, matching the fine-tuning corpus’s own domain.
blocks.zh: ASR强度在各种条件下单调减少: 清洁 (6.0% WER) < Reverb (9.8%) < 噪声 (11.8%) < Telephonny (12.9%) < 重叠 (20.0%) < 环境 (图3-3)),证实联合退化(环境)难度大得多。 所有模型不统一降解 : Whisper Turbo与其蒸馏变体仅在解码器大小上有所不同,其单条件倒塌最陡 (环境为29%的WER),而Qune3-ASR-1.7B离线则全程最强,除了Reverb之外保留了最高的EM. Cohere Offline只落后于两个Quen3-ASR-1.7B变体. 尼莫特龙流线基线与Parakeet在规模上相当,但比Whisper和Qun3-ASR-1.7B小2-4×x\times显示强度较低,可能是因为它使用声学多样性较少的预训数据和模型大小. 微调模型缩小了Telephony的空隙,与微调器本身的域相匹配.

blocks.en: Averaged over the acoustic conditions, overall WER and EM are strongly anti-correlated across models ( r = − 0.93 r=-0.93 ), indicating that WER is generally informative for model-selection. However the relationship varies by accent: correlations range from r = − 0.87 r=-0.87 to − 0.98 -0.98 for 3/4 groups but weaken substantially for Scottish ( r = − 0.29 r=-0.29 ), largely driven by Qwen3-ASR-1.7B Chunking’s disproportionate Scottish WER spike. All four Nemotron Streaming variants show strong within-model correlations ( r = − 0.74 r=-0.74 to − 0.96 -0.96 ) and the same ranking pattern – Southern English achieves marginally higher EM than Scottish despite slightly higher WER – indicating that the pattern is consistent across fine-tuning and lookahead settings. Comparing LA6 (shorter context, lower latency) against LA13 (longer context, higher latency) isolates the lookahead effect. The Baseline configuration improves from 20.0%/64.6% (LA6) to 18.2%/66.5% (LA13), while the Finetuned configuration improves from 17.6%/66.4% to 16.1%/67.9%. This corresponds to a consistent but modest improvement of 1.5–1.8% in WER and 1.5–1.9% in EM.

blocks.en: 5.3 Error analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 错误分析

blocks.en: Impact on downstream tool-calling. In the Clean condition, 21.9% of tool-call predictions were incorrect: time_period is the largest failure mode (33.5%), followed by compare_with (25.4%) and group_by (25.3%); abstention accounts for 16.2%, filter for 12.3%, false positives for 8.7%, and metric is rarely wrong (0.7%) – numeric/temporal arguments drive downstream failure, not metric choice (Section 3.2). This interacts with accent in ways Table 1 ’s condition-averaged spread cannot capture. Other British bundles several distinct regional accents into one category, yet it is the lowest-EM group under most individual conditions for every evaluated model, not just on average. The harder robustness challenge is accent diversity itself rather than any single accent; and fine-tuning narrows this gap.
blocks.zh: 对下游取用工具的影响。 在清洁条件下,21.9%的工具调用预测不正确:时间(3.5%)是最大的故障模式,其次是比较(25.4%)和分组(25.3%);弃权者占16.2%,过滤者占12.3%,假阳性者占8.7%,而公分数很少错误(0.7%) -- -- 数字/时空参数驱动下游故障,而不是衡量选择(第3.2节)。 这与口音相互作用的方式是表1的条件平均分布无法捕捉的。 其他英国将几个不同的区域口音组合成一个类别,然而,在大多数个别条件下,每个被评价的模型都是最低的EM组,而不仅仅是平均的。 更强大的挑战是强调多样性本身,而不是任何单一的口音;微调缩小了这一差距。

blocks.en: Task-critical token preservation matters more than aggregate WER. A common UK retailer name is transcribed correctly in only 56.3% of 2,703 utterances (197 distinct variants; 24.4% dropped outright), and “last quarter” survives verbatim in just 43.3% of 61,786 transcriptions (36.5% dropped, 19.4% flattened to a bare “Q1”–“Q4” label, occasionally “last water”); day counts fare better (85.9–98.4% correct) but show a systematic 60 → \to “sixteen”/“six” confusion – unlike the abstentions below, this substitution returns a confident, wrong answer (a 60-day spending query silently computed over 6 or 16 days instead). These are exactly the tokens tool-calling depends on.
blocks.zh: 任务关键符号保存比聚合WER更重要. 在2,703个单词中,只有56.3%(197个不同的变体;24.4%完全放弃)正确转录了英国零售商的通称,在61,786个单词中,“最后一个季度”仅43.3%(36.5%下降,19.4%平整为“Q1”-“Q4”标签,有时是“最后的水 ” ) , 日票价更好(85.9-98.4%正确),但显示系统性的60-\\=“十六”/“六 ”混淆 — — 与以下弃权者不同,这种替代结果返回了自信的错误答案(60天支出查询在6至16天之间悄悄计算)。 这些正是工具召唤所依赖的标志。

blocks.en: Qualitative cases. Manual inspection reveals two representative failures: an Other British-accent query, “How much have I spent at Tesco last year?” , was transcribed as “Hi Monte Santesco last year” – the merchant name was destroyed, triggering abstention; and “List purchases over £600 in the last 90 days” became “This purchase is over six hundred pounds in the last ninety days” , the dropped imperative again causing abstention. In both cases, a lower-WER system preserved the reference verbatim on the same audio; for the customer, abstention at least surfaces as a retryable stall, unlike the silent wrong answer above.
blocks.zh: 质相相等相. 人工检查揭示出两个代表性的失败:另一个英国人提出的问题是“去年我在特斯科花了多少钱? ”被转写为“Hi Monte Santesco去年” — — 商名被摧毁,引发了弃权;以及“过去90天超过600英镑的单价采购”成为“过去90天的单价采购超过600英镑 ” , 取消的强制要求再次导致弃权。 在这两种情况下,一个更低的WER系统在同一个音频上保留了参考逐字记录;对于客户来说,至少弃用表面作为可重试的摊位,这与上面沉默的错误回答不同.

blocks.en: WER is necessary but not sufficient. Qwen3-ASR-1.7B Chunking has the worst WER observed (49.8% at overlap +5 dB) yet retains 67% EM there, since its errors are mostly filler padding while task-critical financial keywords survive at a higher rate than in lower-WER competitors (e.g., “groceries” 86.8% vs. 76.3% for Whisper Turbo). Consistently, Nemotron Streaming (Finetuned-LA13) beats both Parakeet variants on WER and EM despite streaming (16.1%/67.9% vs. 16.5–16.6%/67.1–67.8%), and Cohere Offline – with no fine-tuning at all – still edges past it (15.3%/70.1%), though both trail Qwen3-ASR-1.7B Offline (11.1%/73.7%). Which words are garbled can matter more than how many : preserving task-critical keywords and intent-bearing tokens is more directly tied to correct tool-calling and end-to-end user experience than aggregate WER alone.
blocks.zh: WER是必需的,但还不够. Qune3-ASR-1.7B (中文(简体) ). 春京观测到的WER最差(在重叠+5分贝时为49.8%),但那里保留了67%的EM,因为其误差大多是填充器,而关键任务的财务关键词存活率高于低WER竞争对手(例如,Whisper Turbo的“grocies”86.8%对76.3%)。 尼莫特龙流线(Finetuned-LA13)尽管流出(16.1%/67.9%对16.5-16.6%/67.1-67.8%),但仍在WER和EM上击败了Parakeet变种(16.1%/67.9%对16.5-16.6%/67.1%-67.8%),而Cohere离线(完全没有微调)仍然在经过(15.3%/70.1%),尽管两条出道的Qune3-ASR-1.7B离线(11.1%/73.7%)。 保存关键任务关键关键字和带有意向符号,

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We conducted a study using CavaBench, our internally collected financial-query benchmark, to identify general trends in how accent, model architecture, and acoustic conditions jointly shape end-to-end ASR accuracy. WER and Exact Match are strongly correlated overall, but different accents reveal different challenges: a single model’s WER spike breaks the correlation for Scottish, while for Other British – which bundles several distinct regional accents into one category – accent diversity itself, not any single accent, is the harder challenge. Aggregate WER also masks the unequal cost of errors: preserving task-critical tokens (merchant names, amounts, dates) matters more than reducing total word errors. The robustness gap itself traces to training data rather than architecture: targeted fine-tuning closed much of it for the smaller streaming model, pointing to efficient streaming models trained on more diverse data as a path to closing the gap with offline counterparts.
blocks.zh: 我们用Cava Bench这个我们内部收集的金融-平仓基准进行了一项研究,以确定口音、模型结构和声学条件如何共同形成端到端ASR精度的一般趋势。 WER和Exact Match在总体上是紧密相联的,但不同的口音揭示出不同的挑战:单一模型的WER突起打破了苏格兰的关联性,而对其他英国人来说 — — 将几个不同的区域口音捆绑在一个类别中 — — 口音本身,而不是任何单一口音,都是更严峻的挑战. 综合WER还掩盖了错误的不平等成本:保存任务关键符号(商号,金额,日期)比减少总的词错误更重要. 强性差距本身可追溯到培训数据而非结构:有针对性的微调关闭了对更小的流线模型的大部分,指出高效的流线模型在更多样化的数据上得到训练,是缩小与离线对应方差距的一个途径。
